mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% within the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 5.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0 indicates contractionary economic conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0 and UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 225.0 indicates high inflation, triggering monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 700.0 thousand units in the prior month signals robust consumer demand for housing, boosting construction sector growth and corporate earnings, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 in the prior month indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing output and corporate profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) above 400000.0 million dollars and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8.0% signals strong consumer spending and labor market conditions, supporting earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 400000.0 and UNRATE < 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 4.5% per annum indicates aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
